body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 4-month rates for Downtown Views 2, Tower 2:

September: AED 19,000
October: AED 19,000
November: AED 19,000
December: AED 19,000

Total: AED 76,000

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be calculated on a monthly basis, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 4-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you.
